title: rRNA Depleted FFPE RNA Library Prep with NEBNext Ultra II Kit for Illumina
author: New England Biolabs
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ubaesie
materials: Briefly spin down the samples in a microcentrifuge.
Proceed directly to Second Strand cDNA Synthesis.

[ ! ] Dilute the (red) NEBNext Adaptor* prior to setting up the ligation reaction in ice-cold Adaptor Dilution Buffer and keep the adaptor on ice. Total RNA Input Dilution Required 1,000 ng–101 ng 5–fold dilution in Adaptor Dilution Buffer 100 ng–10 ng 25–fold dilution in Adaptor Dilution Buffer 5 ng 200–fold dilution in Adaptor Dilution Buffer *The NEBNext adaptor is provided in NEBNext oligos kit. NEB has several oligo kit options, which are supplied separately from the library prep kit.
Proceed immediately to Purification of the Ligation Reaction.

[ ! ] Incubate the sample in a preheated thermocycler with the heated lid set at ≥ 80 °C as follows: Note: If you are following recommendations in Appendix A (Chapter 6), for libraries with longer inserts (> 200 bases), increase the incubation at 42°C from 15 minutes to 50 minutes at Step 2 below. Step 1: 00:10:00 at 25 °C Step 2: 00:15:00 at 42 °C Step 3: 00:15:00 at 70 °C Step 4: Hold at 4 °C

steps.title: Initial Sample Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample in a preheated thermocycler with the heated lid set at 105 °C.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 00:05:00 at 65 °C
Hold at 4 °C

steps.title: Assemble Priming Reaction
steps.instruction: Assemble the Priming Reaction on ice and mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down 10 times.

steps.title: First Strand cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Assemble the first strand synthesis reaction on ice using the following components:

substeps.instruction: Add 10 µl Fragmented and Primed RNA (Step 36)
Add 8 µl NEBNext Strand Specificity Reagent (Cat #E7766)
Add 2 µl NEBNext First Strand Synthesis Enzyme Mix (Cat #E7761)
Total Volume: 20 µl
Mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down 10 times

steps.title: Second Strand cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Assemble the second strand cDNA synthesis reaction on ice by adding the following components to the first strand synthesis product:

substeps.instruction: Add 20 µl First Strand Synthesis Product
Add 8 µl NEBNext Second Strand Synthesis Reaction Buffer with dUTP (10X) (Cat #E7426)
Add 4 µl NEBNext Second Strand Synthesis Enzyme Mix (Cat #E7425)
Add 48 µl Nuclease-free Water (Cat #E7764)
Total Volume: 80 µl
Mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down at least 10 times while keeping the tube on ice
Incubate in a thermocycler for 01:00:00 at 16 °C with the heated lid set at ≤ 40 °C (or off)

steps.title: Purify Second Strand Synthesis Product
steps.instruction: Perform a bead-based cleanup of the second strand synthesis reaction.

substeps.instruction: Vortex NEBNext Sample Purification Beads (Cat #E7767) to resuspend
Add 144 µL (1.8X) of resuspended beads to the ~80 µL reaction and mix well (vortex or pipette 10x)
Incubate for 00:05:00 at room temperature
Briefly spin in a microcentrifuge and place on a magnet; discard supernatant once clear
Add 200 µL freshly prepared 80% ethanol while on the magnet, incubate for 00:00:30, and discard supernatant
Repeat the ethanol wash once more (total of 2 washes)
Air-dry beads on the magnetic rack for up to 5 minutes (do not over-dry; elute when dark brown and glossy)
Remove from rack and elute DNA by adding 53 µL 0.1X TE Buffer (Cat #E7763)
Mix well (vortex or pipette 10x), spin quickly, and incubate for 00:02:00 at room temperature
Place on magnetic rack until clear and transfer 50 µL of supernatant to a clean nuclease-free PCR tube

steps.title: End Prep Reaction
steps.instruction: Assemble the end prep reaction on ice using the second strand synthesis product:

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µl Second Strand Synthesis Product
Add 7 µl NEBNext Ultra II End Prep Reaction Buffer (Cat #E7647)
Add 3 µl NEBNext Ultra II End Prep Enzyme Mix (Cat #E7646)
Total Volume: 60 µl
Mix by pipetting the entire volume up and down at least 10 times using a 100 μl or 200 μl pipette set to 50 μl
Perform a quick spin to collect liquid
Incubate in a thermocycler with heated lid set at ≥ 75 °C: 00:30:00 at 20 °C, then 00:30:00 at 65 °C, then hold at 4 °C

steps.title: Adaptor Ligation
steps.instruction: Assemble the ligation reaction on ice by adding components in the order given to the end prep product:

substeps.instruction: Add 60 µl End Prepped DNA
Add 2.5 µl Diluted Adaptor
Add 1 µl NEBNext Ligation Enhancer (Cat #E7374)
Add 30 µl NEBNext Ultra II Ligation Master Mix (Cat #E7648)
Total Volume: 93.5 µl
Mix by pipetting the entire volume up and down at least 10 times using a 100 μl or 200 μl pipette set to 80 μl
Perform a quick spin to collect liquid
Incubate for 00:15:00 at 20 °C in a thermocycler

steps.title: USER Enzyme Treatment
steps.instruction: Treat the ligation mixture with USER enzyme to activate adaptors.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 µL NEBNext USER Enzyme (Cat #E7458) to the ligation mixture (Total Volume: 96.5 µL)
Mix well and incubate at 37 °C for 00:15:00 with the heated lid set to ≥ 45 °C

steps.title: Purify Ligated DNA
steps.instruction: Perform a bead-based cleanup of the USER-treated DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 87 µL (0.9X) resuspended NEBNext Sample Purification Beads (Cat #E7767) and mix well (vortex or pipette 10x)
Incubate for 00:10:00 at room temperature
Quickly spin and place on a magnetic rack; discard supernatant after ~00:05:00
Add 200 µL freshly prepared 80% ethanol while on the magnet, incubate for 00:00:30, and discard supernatant
Repeat the ethanol wash once more (total of 2 washes)
Briefly spin and return to magnetic rack
Remove residual ethanol and air-dry beads for up to 5 minutes (do not over-dry)
Remove from rack and elute DNA by adding 17 µL 0.1X TE
Mix well, spin quickly, and incubate for 00:02:00 at room temperature
Place on magnet until clear and transfer 15 µL of supernatant to a clean PCR tube

steps.title: PCR Enrichment
steps.instruction: Perform PCR amplification using 10 μM oligos. Choose the option based on primer format:

substeps.instruction: Option A (Separate Primers): 14 µl Adaptor Ligated DNA, 25 µl NEBNext Ultra II Q5 Master Mix, 5 µl Universal PCR Primer/i5 Primer, 5 µl Index (X) Primer/i7 Primer (Total 50 µl)
Option B (Combined Primers): 15 µl Adaptor Ligated DNA, 25 µl NEBNext Ultra II Q5 Master Mix, 10 µl Index (X)/Universal Primer Mix (Total 50 µl)
Mix by gently pipetting up and down 10 times and quickly spin
Incubate in thermocycler with heated lid at 105 °C using these conditions: 1 cycle 98°C for 30s; 7–16 cycles of 98°C for 10s, 65°C for 75s; 1 cycle 65°C for 5 min; hold at 4°C
Adjust PCR cycles based on RNA input: 1,000 ng (7–8 cycles), 100 ng (11–12 cycles), 10 ng (refer to manual/optimize)

steps.title: Final Library Purification
steps.instruction: Perform a final bead-based cleanup of the PCR product.

substeps.instruction: Vortex NEBNext Sample Purification Beads (Cat #E6315) to resuspend
Add 45 µL (0.9X) of resuspended beads to the ~50 µL PCR reaction and mix well (vortex or pipette 10x)
Incubate for 00:05:00 at room temperature
Quickly spin and place on magnetic rack; discard supernatant after ~00:05:00
Add 200 µL freshly prepared 80% ethanol while on the magnet, incubate for 00:00:30, and discard supernatant
Repeat the ethanol wash once more (total of 2 washes)
Air-dry beads on magnetic rack for up to 5 minutes (do not over-dry)
Remove from rack and elute DNA by adding 23 µL 0.1X TE
Mix well (pipette 10x), spin quickly, and incubate for 00:02:00 at room temperature
Place on magnetic rack until clear and transfer 20 µL of supernatant to a clean PCR tube; store at –20°C

steps.title: Library Quality Control
steps.instruction: Verify the library size distribution using a Bioanalyzer.

substeps.instruction: Run 1 µL library on a DNA 1000 chip (or High Sensitivity chip if yield is low)
Confirm a narrow distribution with a peak size of approximately 300 bp
If peaks at ~80 bp or 128 bp are visible, increase sample volume to 50 μl with 0.1X TE and repeat the SPRI/NEBNext bead cleanup
